# Upstream Buzz behavior-test allowlist.
#
# One base filename per line, sorted, naming files under upstream
# <buzz-checkout>/tests/behavior/*.buzz that currently pass when run through
# gopherbuzz (see ../conformance_test.go). This is the parity contract: the
# set may only GROW. TestConformance fails if any listed file stops passing
# (a regression) or if any non-listed file starts passing (an unrecorded
# improvement - add it here instead).
#
# Regenerate by running the suite and diffing:
#   GOPHERBUZZ_UPSTREAM_DIR=~/Repos/buzz go test ./libs/gopherbuzz/ -run TestUpstreamConformance -v
# then add newly-passing files (never remove a line without confirming a
# real regression).
basic-types.buzz
bitwise.buzz
break-continue.buzz
checked-subscript.buzz
dead-branches.buzz
discarded-value.buzz
foreach.buzz
if-arrow.buzz
inferred-var-type.buzz
interpolation.buzz
invoke.buzz
is.buzz
iterator.buzz
jit-hotspot-string-interpolation.buzz
json.buzz
lambda.buzz
list-map-properties.buzz
long-namespace.buzz
namespace.buzz
objects.buzz
operators.buzz
placeholder-cycle.buzz
placeholder-nested-call.buzz
scope.buzz
str.buzz
tail-call.buzz
